title: The Procession
text: A line of penitents whips their own backs as they walk, singing, all going the same way: toward the Court. Their blood spatters the road in a long red line. They ask you, very kindly, to walk with them a while.

options.label: Walk with the penitents, and let them carry you through the Court's gates.

outcomes.text: They take you through the gates as one of theirs, singing, and their blood is on your boots.

options.label: The wisest asks them what they repent, and listens closely.

outcomes.text: Their answers draw a map of the Court's sins.

options.label: Break up the procession. This is no faith worth walking with.

outcomes.text: They do not break easily, and they keep singing as they fight.
